camera_backend_winrt.description: WinRT MediaCapture + MediaFrameReader AcquisitionMode.Realtime as primary camera source

camera_backend_msmf_fallback.description: OpenCV MSMF fallback when WinRT unavailable or forced
camera_backend_msmf_fallback.config_field: camera.backend = MSMF or AUTO with WinRT failure

num_hands_2.description: Detect and track up to 2 hands simultaneously

gesture_like.description: LIKE gesture (thumbs up) triggers NEXT slide (RIGHT ARROW)

gesture_scissors.description: SCISSORS gesture (V/peace sign) triggers PREVIOUS slide (LEFT ARROW)

gesture_blackout.description: OPEN PALM gesture triggers blackout (B key)

keyboard_action_dispatch.description: Dispatch keyboard events (LEFT, RIGHT, B) to active application

preview_window.description: OpenCV imshow preview window with landmark overlay

clean_shutdown.description: Deterministic shutdown: stop_event + thread join + camera.close()

live_stream_worker_mode.description: LIVE_STREAM_WORKER: event-driven control thread, MediaPipe async callback

audio_feedback.description: Optional audio beep on gesture action via winsound or sounddevice
audio_feedback.dependency: winsound (stdlib) is primary; sounddevice is a venv package but NOT directly imported in production code
audio_feedback.analysis: Production code uses 'import winsound' (stdlib, always available) inside _play_feedback_sound. sounddevice is pulled into venv by mediapipe.tasks.python.audio.core.audio_record — NOT by hand_controller. winsound handles the feature. sounddevice is NOT a dependency of the audio_feedback feature.
audio_feedback.verdict: audio_feedback IS A SUPPORTED PRODUCTION FEATURE via winsound (stdlib). sounddevice is NOT required for this feature. sounddevice enters dist only because mediapipe bundles audio_record module which imports it.

process_priority_above_normal.description: Set Windows process priority to ABOVE_NORMAL via psutil

mouseinfo_pyscreeze.description: PyAutoGUI sub-packages for mouse info and screen capture
mouseinfo_pyscreeze.pulled_by: pyautogui package declares them as dependencies
mouseinfo_pyscreeze.analysis: Production only calls pyautogui.press(). mouseinfo and pyscreeze are never called. mouseinfo imports PIL and matplotlib.

sounddevice_standalone.analysis: audio_record.py is part of MediaPipe audio tasks (speech, etc.). Hand Slide Controller uses hand landmarker only, not audio tasks. sounddevice is an indirect transitive MediaPipe dep, NOT needed by hand_controller.
